verdict.rationale: Postman supports mock servers, environments/variables, and Postman Vault, which let AI-native users simulate APIs and separate test data from production without directly hitting live production endpoints. However, there is no explicit documentation of a dedicated 'sandbox environment' concept tied specifically to AI-agent testing, nor confirmation that Agent Mode or MCP integrations are scoped to avoid production data by default. missing for 10: explicit sandbox/production isolation guarantees for AI agent actions, documentation on how Agent Mode avoids mutating production environments, and independent verification of safe-by-default behavior for agentic use.
